lines: AGL Pallet was built from firsthand experience on the manufacturing side, including navigating capacity constraints, material shortages, and pricing volatility during high-pressure periods like COVID. That background shapes how we operate today—knowing when to push for efficiency, when to push back to protect production, and how to design fit-for-purpose pallet solutions without creating unnecessary complexity.

We work with owners, COOs, purchasing teams, and warehouse leaders at both regional and multinational operations that require truckload quantities on a recurring basis. If consistent pallet supply is critical to keeping your operation running, AGL is built to support you.
AGL Pallet was built to bring structure and reliability to an industry that often operates without it.
Beyond specifications, we evaluate handling environments, storage methods, and transportation variables to ensure the recommended solution performs reliably under real-world conditions.
Once requirements are defined, we align your needs with trusted manufacturing partners selected for their capacity, quality controls, and consistency.

Our supplier network is built around reliability and scalability. We prioritize manufacturers capable of meeting recurring volume demands while maintaining structural standards and predictable lead times. This ensures your supply chain remains stable even during seasonal shifts or growth phases.

By overseeing logistics directly, we create a single point of accountability between manufacturing and delivery. This reduces communication gaps, improves scheduling accuracy, and helps prevent production interruptions caused by material shortages.

Large-scale manufacturing environments demand consistency, durability, and dependable supply. In fast-paced production settings, even minor disruptions in pallet performance or availability can create costly delays across procurement, warehousing, and outbound logistics. Our solutions are built to support operations where efficiency, uptime, and structural reliability are non-negotiable.

Heavy, dense, and often irregular loads require pallets engineered for strength and load distribution. We support manufacturers and distributors of lumber, stone, roofing materials, and construction components with durable solutions designed to withstand demanding handling conditions and outdoor storage environments.

In regulated environments where cleanliness, consistency, and traceability matter, pallet integrity plays a critical role. We help pharmaceutical manufacturers maintain compliant, dependable material handling systems that support sensitive product transport and controlled warehouse operations.

Plastic product manufacturers often manage high production volumes and rapid distribution cycles. Our pallet solutions are designed to support lightweight but bulk shipments, automated handling systems, and efficient stacking configurations that maximize storage density.

High-throughput food and beverage operations depend on reliable material handling to maintain distribution timelines. Our solutions support consistent load performance, warehouse efficiency, and repeatable handling processes across regional supply chains.

Our stock pallets are designed for businesses that value consistency, speed, and cost efficiency. With standardized dimensions and proven load performance, they’re ideal for warehousing, retail distribution, logistics, and export operations. Every pallet is produced under strict quality controls to ensure durability, structural integrity, and dependable performance across multiple handling cycles.
Using Pallet Design System (PDS) methodology, AGL designs pallets precisely tailored to your load requirements, weight capacities, and operational conditions — without overbuilding or overspending.

Every supply chain has unique demands. From dynamic loads in transit to static warehouse storage and racking systems, engineered pallets ensure optimal performance under real-world conditions. Through detailed analysis of product weight, stacking patterns, handling methods, and environmental factors, we develop pallet specifications that maximize strength while minimizing unnecessary material usage.

Shipping blocks play a critical role in reinforcing load integrity during storage, handling, and transport. Whether used to elevate products, create spacing for forklift access, stabilize irregular items, or distribute weight more evenly, these components improve safety and reduce the risk of damage throughout the supply chain.
Built From Inside the Manufacturing World
